snippet.title: Joe James
snippet.description:
Learn math and computer science with a focus on Python and Java programming, brought to you directly from Silicon Valley. Joe James holds a masters degree in computer science and an MBA, lives in Fremont, California and is a tech industry veteran currently working as a Software Engineer at Samsung.

If you like my videos please click Like, and subscribe to my channel. I welcome any comments and feedback. You can get most of the code from my videos at the GitHub link below. Contributions at the Patreon link below are always welcome.

My brother Brian James is an Aikido Master. Check out his channel at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPh32edWwNcGDnDr3-3g3EA
